lines.beaver_en: Hello. How can I help you?
lines.learner: 증명서를 떼고 싶어요. 발급이 몇 시까지예요?
lines.en: I'd like to get a certificate. Until what time is issuance?
lines.roman: jeungmyeongseoreul ttego sipeoyo. balgeubi myeot sikkajiyeyo?

lines.beaver: 다섯 시까지예요. 지금은 네 시 반이에요.
lines.beaver_en: Until five. It's four thirty now.
lines.beaver_roman: daseot sikkajiyeyo. jigeumeun ne si banieyo.
lines.learner: 다행이에요. 세 시에 오려고 했는데 늦었어요.
lines.en: What a relief. I meant to come at three, but I was late.
lines.roman: dahaengieyo. se sie oryeogo haenneunde neujeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: That's okay. Please give me your ID.
lines.learner: 여기 있어요. 발급은 몇 분 걸려요?
lines.en: Here it is. How many minutes does issuance take?
lines.roman: yeogi isseoyo. balgeubeun myeot bun geollyeoyo?

lines.beaver: 십 분쯤 걸려요. 어떤 증명서가 필요하세요?
lines.beaver_en: About ten minutes. Which certificate do you need?
lines.beaver_roman: sip bunjjeum geollyeoyo. eotteon jeungmyeongseoga piryohaseyo?
lines.en: A tax payment certificate. I have to submit it to my company.

lines.beaver: 네, 이 서류를 써 주세요. 주소도 써 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Okay, please fill out this form. Your address too.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, i seoryureul sseo juseyo. jusodo sseo juseyo.
lines.en: My address is in Gangwon Province, but I work in Seoul.

lines.beaver: 다 쓰셨어요? 이제 네 시 사십 분이에요.
lines.beaver_en: All done? It's now four forty.
lines.beaver_roman: da sseosyeosseoyo? ije ne si sasip bunieyo.
lines.learner: 네, 다 썼어요. 다섯 시 전에 끝나요?
lines.en: Yes, I'm done. Will it be finished before five?
lines.roman: ne, da sseosseoyo. daseot si jeone kkeunnayo?

lines.beaver: 네, 네 시 오십 분에 나와요. 의자에 앉아 계세요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, it'll be ready at four fifty. Please have a seat.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, ne si osip bune nawayo. uijae anja gyeseyo.
lines.en: Thank you. The staff are really kind.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. Please wait just a moment.
lines.learner: 네. 이 구청은 몇 시에 문을 열어요?
lines.en: Okay. What time does this district office open?
lines.roman: ne. i gucheongeun myeot sie muneul yeoreoyo?

lines.beaver: 아침 아홉 시에 열고 저녁 여섯 시에 닫아요.
lines.beaver_en: It opens at nine in the morning and closes at six in the evening.
lines.beaver_roman: achim ahop sie yeolgo jeonyeok yeoseot sie dadayo.
lines.en: Then why is issuance only until five?

lines.beaver: 다섯 시 이후에는 서류를 정리해요. 증명서 나왔어요!
lines.beaver_en: After five we sort the paperwork. Your certificate is ready!
lines.beaver_roman: daseot si ihueneun seoryureul jeongnihaeyo. jeungmyeongseo nawasseoyo!
lines.learner: 와, 네 시 오십 분이네요. 정말 감사합니다!
lines.en: Wow, it's exactly four fifty. Thank you so much!
lines.roman: wa, ne si osip bunineyo. jeongmal gamsahamnida!
